sections.title: Hair cuts and treatments in downtown Miami
sections.subtitle: A full menu of cuts, color and hair treatments, for clients who want their hair done well.

items.name: Haircut
items.description: A cut shaped to your face, hair type and the way you wear it day to day.

items.name: Blowout
items.description: A wash and blow-dry, smooth or with volume, ready for the rest of your day.

items.name: Hair color
items.description: Full color, root touch-up or highlights, planned with you before we begin.

items.name: Hair treatments
items.description: Deep conditioning and repair treatments for dry, damaged or stressed hair.

sections.intro: Choose a service and a time that works for you.
sections.title: Book online

items.a: We take walk-ins when a stylist has an opening. Booking ahead is the surer way to get a time that suits you.
It depends on the service. A cut or blowout is usually under an hour, and color takes longer. You will see the time when you book.
items.q: How long does an appointment take?

items.a: Please give us at least 24 hours' notice so we can offer your time to another client.
